title: Go Faster
body:
# Go Faster
A quality of life client side mod. Adds configurable speed and fall distance indicators on screen.

Supports [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config).

Ispired by [Crosshair Addons](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshair-addons-public) by Walksy, check it out!
